about: Registry of registries (F-26, under #3673). Every registry-shaped artefact in this repo is either a row here, an artefact or closure check of a row, a gate row, or a named as-read exception below. Enforced by scripts/registry-manifest-check.mjs (meta-census + per-family closure), wired into scripts/check.mjs and pinned by tests/registry-manifest.test.js. Seeded from atlas-8 R1-R33 plus battery-gamma's five additions (A1-A5) and two post-atlas rows found by this lane's census (A6-A8); every row re-verified at the seed base below.
